notes.title: BRUSH BURIAL TWO is Available to WISHLIST!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=M0wHJmSYGgo;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey everyone! Hope you're enjoying the game.
As you may have heard, I'm working on a sequel right now. Or if you hadn't heard, now you have! :)
It's an extension of the first game's strongest aspects, with some new weapons, fresh combat mechanics, and lots and lots of important improvements. I'm so proud of it thus far, and I think it should be particularly enticing for those of you who enjoyed the sewer skulking of Brush Burial's front half.
You can find the steam page for it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3594120/Brush_Burial_2/]here[/url]. If you don't mind, pressing the wishlist button goes a long way.
ALSO! There is a rough demo available, at that other place, you know, the scratchy one. Saying anything more about that would be a breach of decorum. Go looking if you're curious.
That's all I've got for you folks. Thanks for supporting me, helping me buy groceries. This game's done a lot for my life and gratitude for that is sort of hard to communicate. So Thanks.

- tris 💚

(P.S. if you haven't given Brush Burial a review yet, I'd love to hear what you have to say. Even just a sentence or two and a Yes or No recommendation is pretty important for a small project like mine. Thanks again and take care.)

notes.title: a small patch. 3.6.25
notes.content:
finally got around to a few odds and ends i've been losing sleep over. expect the following:
- mouse look should be less jittery, for those of you who were experiencing that.
- resolution settings should now apply properly.
- tutorial text should be easier to read.
i say 'should' because i can only account for the changes i tried to make and the limited playtesting i could bother some friends to do for me. if any of this isn't working correctly, feel free to get a hold of me, through whatever channels.
that's it. thank you all. 💚

notes.title: Brush Burial But Better
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735211/596294ef12b007b9f1c09a4afeea682d3c4e095a.png[/img]
A slew of bug fixes and tweaks to make the game more presentable.
Most notably:
- Fixed the resolution settings not saving when changed
- Lessened the much-maligned pixilation effect during gameplay
- Reworked the 'Gem Pouch' item to be less buggy
- Added several new items to Act 2 to allow for new strategies
- Improved the game's soundtrack
- Fixed a soft-lock in the tutorial (an important key could fall through the ground)
- Act select (post-game) now fully resets the level (but not inventory)
- Probably some other stuff I can't remember at the moment. Go poke around and see for yourself :)
